newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys May N+A naphtha at close to $230/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys May N+A naphtha at close to $230/T.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has bought by tender 28,000 tonnes of napthenic and aromatic (N+A) naphtha for delivery May 11-31 at just below $230 per tonne on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Kaohsiung, a company offcial said on Tuesday.
"It is a little bit below $230", the official said.
CPC received up to four offers in the tender which closed March 24 and was valid for a day.
The award is higher than CPC's last purchase of N+A in early March for April 16-30 delivery was at $210-$215 per tonne on a c-and-f basis.
